_comment: Amendments (RuleManager): the rulebook can change mid-match. 'turns' = how many full rounds a rule lasts (0 = until repealed). 'effects' are keys the rules read through RuleManager.value(key, default). If two active rules set the same key, the higher 'priority' wins; on a tie the newer one. At most 'limit' rules at once: adding one more repeals the oldest temporary one (or the oldest). The win condition (most Dead Rats) can't be amended away.
